scenario: the first practical exchange about walking & getting around
english_title: Recognising and Responding to the First Practical Exchange About Walking and Getting Around
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: walking & getting around — the first practical exchange about walking & getting around
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to the first practical exchange about walking & getting around; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Ms Lan asks Ms Anna how far the stadium is.
context_note_vi: Chị Lan hỏi chị Anna sân vận động cách đây bao xa.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: Anna, how far is the stadium from here?
turns.vietnamese: Anna này, sân vận động cách đây bao xa vậy?

turns.speaker: Ms Anna
turns.vietnamese: Khoảng hai mươi phút đi bộ.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: That is a bit far. Thank you.
turns.vietnamese: Vậy hơi xa đấy. Cảm ơn chị.
